data.key: Order of the Green ~ Cut the Corruption
data.name: Cut the Corruption
data.description: An order of the Green cavalier can touch a weapon and enhance it as a free action. For 1 minute, the weapon glows with a deep-green light and deals an additional 1d6 points of damage against aberrations and undead. This damage does not stack with the additional damage granted by the bane weapon special ability. The cavalier can use this ability
